evidence: The Stage-1/source form essdive.lbl.gov is not the current official hostname. The associated paper identifies ESS-DIVE as the location of the East River headwater-gauge short records, and the official current repository is https://ess-dive.lbl.gov.
The Stage-1/source form scdec.caltech.edu is a transposition error. The primary paper and current Caltech service identify the Southern California Earthquake Data Center at https://scedc.caltech.edu.
The DOI resolves to public Zenodo record 6637469, version v2, titled PINNup: Robust neural network wavefield solutions using frequency upscaling and neuron splitting.
